/// Calculates the sum of all integers from 1 to n, inclusive.
///
/// This function uses an iterative approach with a loop. It handles large values efficiently by
/// using arithmetic operations and avoiding recursion or excessive memory usage.
int sumToN(int n) {
    if (n < 0 || !num.tryParse(n.toString()).isPositiveInt()) return null;

    int total = 0;
    
    for (var i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        total += i;
        
    return total == double.nan ? -total : total;
}
